WGU’s transfer rules

  • Up to 90 competency units from other sources can count toward the 120-unit degree.
  • WGU caps alternative credit at 90 competency units.

Source: WGU November 2026 undergraduate catalog: transfer ceiling and named degree requirements

Published university rate: $4,125 per 6 months. The number of paid terms depends on the work you finish. Outside courses and separate charges are additional. See the rate source.

Questions

Does Saylor Business Statistics transfer to Western Governors University?

WGU’s published transfer guidance lists Saylor Business Statistics for C955 Applied Probability and Statistics (3 competency units) in the Software Engineering, with conditions. Ask WGU to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Study.com Philosophy 104: Contemporary Trends in Technology and Ethics transfer to Western Governors University?

WGU’s published transfer guidance lists Study.com Philosophy 104: Contemporary Trends in Technology and Ethics for E068 Ethical Engineering (3 competency units) in the Software Engineering, with conditions. Ask WGU to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Study.com English 104: College Composition I transfer to Western Governors University?

WGU’s published transfer guidance lists Study.com English 104: College Composition I for D270 Composition: Successful Self-Expression (3 competency units) in the Software Engineering, with conditions. Ask WGU to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into Western Governors University’s Software Engineering?

WGU’s published limit for this 120-unit degree is 90 competency units from other sources. This plan proposes 29 competency units through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Western Governors University?

In this plan, 91 competency units are taken at WGU, including E064 Mathematics for Programmers, E075 Special Topics in Software Engineering and AI and E076 Applied Software Engineering.

Has Western Governors University confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need WGU’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Ask the school: how many credits must I earn at the school itself for this degree? Some of the school’s published rules for this program are still being confirmed. Ask the school to confirm this plan before paying for outside courses. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always WGU’s decisions.
